select * from (select projBase.client_id, projBase.proj_name, IFNULL(aoc.apply_credit_amount, IFNULL(factoring.apply_credit_amount, lease.apply_credit_amount)) apply_credit_amount, IFNULL(aoc2.apply_credit_amount, IFNULL(factoring2.apply_credit_amount, lease2.apply_credit_amount)) establish_apply_credit_amount, projBase.biz_type, projBase.establish_id, projBase.review_id, projBase.proj_sponsor_user_id, projBase.create_time, projBase.biz_dept_id, projSettle.settled settled, projPay.payed, clt.belong_sponsor_id, clt.belong_dept_id, IFNULL(establishFlow.assignees, IFNULL(reviewFlow.assignees, projContractFlow.assignees)) assignees, IFNULL(establishFlow.flow_type, IFNULL(reviewFlow.flow_type, projContractFlow.flow_type)) flow_type, IFNULL(establishFlow.start_time, IFNULL(reviewFlow.start_time, projContractFlow.start_time)) start_time, projEffected.effected, projInvested.invested, establish_status, establish_process_status, review_status, review_process_status, case when effected =0 then 'NOT_EFFECT' when effected = 1 and payed is null then 'NOT_PAY' when payed>0 and (invested is null or invested = 0) then 'NOT_INVEST' when invested = 1 AND (settled is null OR settled =0) then 'NOT_SETTLE' end projLifecycleStatus from lifecycle_proj projBase join client clt on clt.id = projBase.client_id left join proj_review_aoc_price aoc on projBase.review_id = aoc.project_id left join proj_review_factoring_price factoring on projBase.review_id = factoring.project_id left join proj_review_lease_price lease on projBase.review_id = lease.project_id left join proj_establish_aoc_price aoc2 on projBase.establish_id = aoc2.proj_establish_id left join proj_establish_factoring_price factoring2 on projBase.establish_id = factoring2.proj_establish_id left join proj_establish_lease_price lease2 on projBase.establish_id = lease2.proj_establish_id
left join lifecycle_proj_settle projSettle on projBase.review_id = projSettle.proj_review_id
left join lifecycle_establish_flow establishFlow ON projBase.establish_id = establishFlow.establish_id
left join lifecycle_review_flow reviewFlow ON projBase.review_id = reviewFlow.review_id
left join lifecycle_proj_contract_flow projContractFlow on projBase.review_id = projContractFlow.proj_review_id left join lifecycle_proj_effected projEffected on projBase.review_id = projEffected.proj_review_id left join lifecycle_proj_invested projInvested on projBase.review_id = projInvested.proj_review_id left join lifecycle_proj_pay projPay on projBase.review_id = projPay.proj_review_id ) result
AND client_id = #{req.clientId} AND proj_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.projName},'%') AND biz_type=#{req.bizType} AND biz_dept_id=#{req.bizDeptId} AND proj_sponsor_user_id =#{req.projSponsorUserId} AND create_time >= #{req.projestablishFrom} AND create_time <= #{req.projestablishTo} AND review_id is null AND review_id is not null AND settled is null AND settled = 1
AND settled is not null AND settled =0
and establish_status = #{req.establishStatus} and establish_process_status = #{req.establishProcessStatus}
and review_status = #{req.reviewStatus} and review_process_status = #{req.reviewProcessStatus}
AND establish_status='NEW' AND establish_status='TAKE_EFFECT' AND review_status IS NULL
AND review_status='NEW' AND review_status='TAKE_EFFECT' AND effected is null
AND effected = 0 AND effected = 1 and payed is null AND payed>0 and (invested is null or invested = 0)
AND invested = 1 AND (settled is null OR settled =0)
AND settled=1
AND belong_dept_id IN #{item}
AND belong_sponsor_id=#{req.sponsorId}
